First ask whether violating this condition changes an admitted product, authority, trust, evidence, eligibility, or lifecycle decision. Do not infer domain significance from a long condition, a call to require(), or policy-sounding names alone. Choose needs_review if the bounded source does not establish the rule's meaning or impact. Never invent omitted context.
